---
subject: A Midwest design studio's first hire, and what it changed
---

A small design studio in the Midwest just added its first hire. The lead designer kept the client
conversation; the new hire took over the pulls. The next project ran itself instead of leaning on
memory and sticky notes.

Patina is the tool behind the handoff: Designer-Taught Intelligence that surfaces the right pull,
at the right place, for the studio's own crew. No lock-in, no hidden fees, one agreed direction for
the homeowner.

Happy to connect you with the studio for a short interview.
